scope: The full-height unfinished brick-and-steel Jezreel’s Tower on Chatham Hill in August 1903. Includes the four open exterior elevations and the documented bare steel assembly hall roof skeleton.

originalReview.notes: The original postcard already published on Qualla matches the native Commons bytes and a separate hand-postmarked 1907 Shurey printing. Used for the exterior palette, divisions and broad image proportions.

The original August 1903 issue prints one surviving exterior and two interior photographs from the unfinished building. Captions say From a Photo without identifying a photographer. The article author is credited separately. UK anonymous-publication and US original-publication terms have expired.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with the public-domain coloured postcard already on Qualla. A separate 1907-postmarked copy and the contemporary 1903 periodical photographs confirm the unfinished tower form before the walls were reduced.
